Trump labels US Democrats as 'godless communists', signals Republican strategy

US President Donald Trump has labeled US Democrats as 'godless communists', a move seen as part of the Republican Party's strategy for the upcoming midterms. The comments were made during a recent speech, where Trump also referred to communism as the greatest threat to the US since World Wars and 9/11. This stance is likely to further polarize the US political landscape.
